title: Find the width and endpoints
text: The width is $$dx=\frac{2}{n}$$ and the left endpoints are $$1+\frac{2\left(i-1\right)}{n}$$, which start at $$1$$ and run up to $$3$$.

title: Identify f
text: The summand is the endpoint $$x$$ itself, so the limit is the integral of $$x$$ from $$1$$ to $$3$$.
